name: Command Palette
description: A ⌘K command palette with grouped results, fuzzy search with highlighter-pen matches, keyboard navigation, shortcut hints and proper combobox ARIA.

props.name: groups
props.type: { id: string; label: string; items: CommandItem[] }[]
props.description: Result groups in order. Items take id, label, keywords, shortcut, hint and a lucide icon.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on first render. ⌘K or Ctrl+K toggles it after that.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the search field on first render. Later opens always focus it.

props.name: workspace
props.description: Name in the demo app drawn behind the palette.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item on Enter or click.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the outer section.
